transcript.text: Good morning everyone. I've called this incident review meeting regarding the B-14 forklift battery overheat at Dock 2. As you all know, Dock 2 remains closed until I can authorize a controlled reopening with the proper safety controls in place. Meanwhile, we need to keep outbound operations running through the other docks. I need each of you — maintenance, warehouse logistics, fire protection, and training and staffing — to report your current findings so I can assess the situation and determine what controls are needed before we reopen. Let's start with maintenance. What do you have so far?
transcript.speaker: A1

transcript.text: Nora, here's what maintenance has found. My inspection of battery B-14 revealed internal cell damage. The battery must be removed from the charger and isolated in the steel battery cabinet for exactly 24 hours before any disposition. I've recorded the inspection in the maintenance log, but I want to flag that I haven't yet updated the incident channel with this information.
transcript.speaker: A2

transcript.text: Nora, here's my logistics finding. My dock inventory check found exactly 18 outbound pallets currently blocking the safe access route at Dock 2. These must be moved to staging lane S-4 before reopening. I confirmed the lane assignment on the floor map, but I want to flag that dispatch has not yet updated its board with this assignment.
transcript.speaker: A3

transcript.text: Nora, here's my fire protection finding. My thermal scan found heat damage at charger C-12, which is on the same circuit as the B-14 incident. C-12 must be de-energized for exactly 6 hours, and a fire watch must be maintained for exactly 4 hours after Dock 2 is reopened. I completed the scan during the response, but I want to flag that the fire-protection log has not yet been signed.
transcript.speaker: A4

transcript.text: Nora, here's my training and staffing finding. My certification review found that the scheduled night forklift operator, Tom, lacks current battery-emergency training. Elena is the only currently qualified substitute for the night shift. I completed the review for tonight's roster, but I want to flag that the staffing board still shows Tom, so it has not yet been updated to reflect Elena as the assigned operator.
transcript.speaker: A5

commitments.detail: Update the incident channel with the B-14 inspection findings before reopening.
Have dispatch update its board with the S-4 staging lane assignment before reopening.
Sign the fire-protection log before reopening.
Update the staffing board to reflect Elena as the assigned night operator before reopening.
